summary: Walks the registry linked list headed by dword_8B8E20 comparing each node's name string (offset 0x14) with a1's name (a1+20) via strcmp. On match, unlinks a1 from the list with DoublyLinkedListNodeRemoval_d3a0, calls AudioResourceCleanup, and, if a1 is non-null, calls EmptyStub_7470 then frees the node via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns early (no cleanup) when the head is null or the list end is reached without a match.

operations.description: Load the registry list head: v1 = dword_8B8E20.
If the list head dword_8B8E20 is non-null, traverse the list.
while strcmp((const char *)(v1 + 20), a1 + 20): walk nodes until the name at offset 0x14 equals a1's name.
Advance to the next node: v1 = *(_DWORD *)(v1 + 2160); the node's next pointer lives at offset 2160.
If the next pointer v1 becomes null (end of list), return without any cleanup.
DoublyLinkedListNodeRemoval_d3a0(a1): unlink the matching node from the registry linked list.
AudioResourceCleanup(a1): release audio resource fields owned by the node.
Proceed to stub and free only if a1 is non-null.
EmptyStub_7470(a1): call the empty stub on the node.
Implicit return when the list ends before a name match (next pointer null).

unresolved: The ABI lead names the search 'matching wide string', but the code compares narrow strings with strcmp; the discrepancy is unresolved.
Node type and meaning of the name field at offset 0x14 and the next pointer at offset 2160 are inferred from usage and not independently confirmed.
